statement: Each swap clause in the proof body carries an allowance on both tokens, sized to what remains (a Left maker's give lowers Left's delta, its want raises it; a Right maker's the inverse), or the finalize would revert (R-SWAP-ONCHAIN). The clause follows the payment clauses, swap clauses in slot order, deltaIndex = token position, and shrinks with every fill. The Arrival cell holds that every clause allows both legs, in full, of what remains, and that a clause with no allowance on a leg makes the finalize refuse; the clause order (after the payment clauses, slot order), deltaIndex and the clamp of an allowance below the fill are on no page (here an allowance is the remainder, so it never bites).
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
